factionInit._comment_salesInventory: The DECATHL○N line (Items/Clothing/Shop_Decathlon_sports.json): sportswear (exercise commands' clothingFit) and swimwear (com_furniture_swim); plus sports furniture (packed furniture tagged sports_equipment - only sold here, the furniture store excludes it).
factionInit._comment_assignableMemberTypes: As store_furniture.json: regular part-time clerks use six-hour early/late shifts with complementary 14-day A/B schedules. The old all-day leaf is reserved for fallback generation; no recruiting UI is added.
factionInit._comment_fallbackWorkers: Minimum coverage 1, fallback cap 1; on-duty regular clerks count toward coverage.
factionInit._comment_floors: intentionally empty - this faction's room lives on the shared JP_ShoppingStreet floor (floor_jp_shopping_street), assigned via that room's factionOwnerOverwrite. See Manageable.AddToFaction(Floor_Instance,...).
